items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: I was with Big Curtis. He came, got me, we're going on the road.

ctx.x: First time. We were, and this was in 1953. 52? Or 53. And I was with Big Curtis. He came, got me, we're going on the road. He went to Nashville. But Christmas night, we played in Opelousa. Packed up like this. I don't know what it was. I can't remember, but I do know this. When we knocked off that night, because we, from there was going on to Nashville. Curtis gave me a lot of relief. And I was with Big Curtis. We were, he came, got me, we're going on the road. We headed to Nashville. But Christmas night, we…
I don't know what it was.
